title: Kris Jenner lists the iconic Hidden Hills family home featured on Keeping Up with the Kardashians for $13.5M
text:
Kris Jenner is selling her family home.
The Kardashians matriarch has decided that it is time to say goodbye to the palatial house where she and her family welcomed the world during their successful reality show keeping up with the kardashians.
The 69 -year -old reality star, who, according to the reports, spent millions renewing the great property told the New York Times “I have shared so many unforgettable memories in this incredible house with my family, and I am excited to see that a new chapter with its next owners begins.”
The property of 8,860 square feet has been listed for $ 13.5 million. It is located in the Tony area of ​​Hidden Hills and has six rooms in suite and two additional bathrooms.
The main suite provides an experience in the form of a full spa with a bathroom with a steam shower, a private gym and a balcony with property view.
The famous mansion provided the stage for numerous scenes in Kuwtk during his career from 2007 to 2021.
